purpose: Historical branch-and-fold fixture dramatizing the Ceres Control War maintenance-continuity roster as a political struggle over split evidence custody, life-safety labor, supply access, and claimshare pressure.

local_awareness_summary.text: Len Rusk is a pressure mechanic and union shift delegate who knows Collar Four's live systems, crew fatigue, witnessed handovers, gate states, and household needs, but not who caused the sensor-history gap.
The strike roster separates AIR life-safety duties from ORE production, letting workers maintain pressure and cooling while refusing extraction.
Len's leverage is distributed: union handovers, Forge repair provenance, AU exception authority and freight, SolEx baselines and claimshares, and PSC classification each remain useful and dangerous.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective remains Len's embodied position inside one transfer-collar maintenance bay; choices use handovers, food, service rails, gates, consoles, sealed wafers, and bounded contract decisions.
Tonal mode is dry workplace comedy under noir institutional pressure, with quiet mutual aid established before the evidentiary crisis.

authority_boundaries.text: Len can perform life-safety work, control the local ore gate and union records, display or withhold evidence, and negotiate a bounded disposition; Len cannot command AU freight, rewrite SolEx baselines, or decide PSC classification directly.
Pax controls Forge disclosure, Vela controls AU exceptions and parts, Imri controls SolEx submissions and release offers, and the off-frame PSC observer controls market classification only.

object_custody.text: The union handover wafers, Forge slate, AU exception ledger, SolEx baseline, ore-gate custody socket, replacement actuator crate, meal stores, and PSC composite are separate objects or records whose access changes outcomes.

required_semantics.text: Every ending must preserve the distinction between life-safety continuity and extractive throughput while showing who gained access, custody, material relief, or delay.
Mutual aid can extend crew capacity at human scale but cannot replace parts, sleep, or infrastructure indefinitely.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not reveal who caused the missing sensor interval, create a unified Belt movement, or let a PSC classification settle the moral truth of the strike.
Do not make AU aid altruistic, SolEx pressure purely military, Forge openness costless, or union continuity labor inexhaustible.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Three choice layers fold through the PSC classification window and route to eight state-gated political endings.

branches.actor_intent: Use food and a written sleep order to preserve the crew that makes continuity possible.
state_basis: Len knows the night crew's fatigue and has custody of the shift roster and shared flask.
reviewed_consequences: Raises mutual_aid and crew_endurance while increasing unpaid claimshare exposure.

branches.actor_intent: Build a witnessed repair-provenance chain before the PSC window opens.
state_basis: Len can traverse the clipped service rail with Pax and identify installed repair history.
reviewed_consequences: Raises Forge authentication, record integrity, and safety margin while spending crew endurance.

branches.actor_intent: Distribute duplicate handovers without creating one institutional owner.
state_basis: Len controls the union locker, custody wafers, and public-reader position.
reviewed_consequences: Raises local custody, record integrity, and public visibility while strengthening SolEx suspicion.

branches.actor_intent: Make the AIR versus ORE distinction physically inspectable at the gate.
state_basis: Len can operate the handwheel and custody socket while preserving the separate life-safety bypass.
reviewed_consequences: Raises production hold, safety margin, and record integrity while strengthening the SolEx emergency case.

branches.actor_intent: Authenticate the sensor splice without transferring the full Forge archive.
state_basis: Pax can expose a narrow provenance pane under the PSC camera.
reviewed_consequences: Raises Forge authentication, record integrity, and local custody while tightening the replacement window.

branches.actor_intent: Spend AU's liability admission as evidence without transferring union handovers.
state_basis: Vela can open the signed exception ledger; Len can keep the roster behind sealed glass.
reviewed_consequences: Raises AU concession, PSC classification strength, and record integrity while thinning local custody.

branches.actor_intent: Permit inspection of union handovers while refusing transfer into SolEx custody.
state_basis: The transparent reader can display sealed wafers while its transfer port remains capped.
reviewed_consequences: Raises roster visibility, record integrity, and local custody while weakening the SolEx case.

branches.actor_intent: Submit a composite for bounded-labor recognition while contributors retain source custody.
state_basis: Success requires strong record integrity, Forge authentication, and surviving local custody.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to recognized bounded labor action or an uninsured composite that preserves truth but loses parts access.

branches.actor_intent: Trade bounded summary authority to AU for parts, relief, and local-roster recognition.
state_basis: Success requires a prior AU liability concession and enough mutual-aid capacity for collective clause review.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a bounded alliance or AU capture of the roster as a Ramp instrument.

branches.actor_intent: Exchange one freight cycle for household relief without conceding emergency custody.
state_basis: Success requires a weakened SolEx case and enough safety margin to run the cycle within the local gate boundary.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a time-bounded exchange or a mid-cycle SolEx emergency-custody seizure.

branches.actor_intent: Keep production shut and use local stores to buy another shift of refusal.
state_basis: Success requires crew endurance, mutual aid, and a remaining replacement window.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to another survivable local shift or an exhausted manual hold after the replacement berth is lost.

review_passes.detected_tonal_mode: Dry workplace comedy under noir institutional pressure, ending in bounded material care rather than movement-scale triumph.
acceptance_notes: A first pass found that despun, frame-transfer orientation, and claimshares arrived too compressed for a new reader; the opening now defines the nonrotating hub, gravity transition, and project-linked pay/access credits in scene.
A fake-variable audit found psc_classification was written but not read; the shared disposition now displays the recognized AU exception and the AU-addendum success gate reads that state.
All four principal characters and their material levers are introduced before the sensor gap, and no folded scene assumes optional onboarding.

vault_backfill_candidates.candidate_fact: Maintenance-continuity rosters separated life-safety work from extraction and divided necessary evidence among labor, Forge, AU, SolEx, and PSC observers.
vault_backfill_candidates.artifact_origin: The fixture's AIR/ORE roster, split record custody, and state-gated disposition.
vault_backfill_candidates.why_it_belongs: It makes the war's labor mutiny and enclosure politics concrete for future stories, gameplay, and institutional modeling.
vault_backfill_candidates.how_to_add_without_bloat: Added as one plainly marked authored-elaboration subsection before fixture drafting.

acceptance_notes: The lore patch names owner, constituencies, dependencies, leverage, costs, and failure conditions without founding a new faction or universal regulator.
Bloom Eighteen, Collar Four, the cast, sensor gap, and all outcomes are explicitly fixture-local drafts in the lore digest.
The cause of the sensor gap remains unresolved; no branch promotes sabotage speculation into canon.

major_findings.problem: The textual scene-set specification has no rendered plan view or 3D blockout for the repeated multi-angle collar bay.
major_findings.why_it_matters: Text prompts cannot guarantee that image generation will preserve the bearing wall, desk triangle, freight iris, gates, routes, and record sightlines across sixteen frames.
major_findings.evidence: The fixture reuses one room from six camera slots and makes physical access and object custody part of branch meaning.
major_findings.fix_direction: Before website rendering, build a durable camera-specific plan view or 3D blockout from the supplied fixed zones, routes, sightlines, camera slots, and gate states.

missing_scene_set_needs.evidence: Sixteen prompts revisit the same collar from six camera slots.
missing_scene_set_needs.fix_direction: Create the declared plan view or blockout before rendering.

acceptance_notes: A first pass replaced memory-dependent same-room phrasing with complete standalone geometry and removed unexplained TCS jargon from image prompts.
All sixteen Ink visual ids map one-to-one to standalone base prompts and the BFL manifest contains sixteen matching concept prompts.
Character refs are included only for people visible in each frame; the remote PSC observer stays represented by camera and clock.
Verdict accepts the visual plan and manifest as concept-ready collateral, not high-consistency replay art, until the declared blockout exists.

review_passes.inferred_layout_summary: One wedge-shaped bay turns with the habitat city. Apparent gravity points toward its grated outward deck and weakens through the hubward iris into a nonrotating transfer tube. A curved frame-transfer bearing and pressure collar occupy the outward side; an inward ramp reaches the crew corridor; the hubward iris contains separate ore and life-safety paths. Three consoles surround a central meal table with union locker and public reader below. A small outward hatch reaches a clipped service rail beside the bearing.

diagram_or_visual_plan_needs.reason: Generated multi-angle art needs durable geometry for the desk triangle, bearing wall, iris, routes, and custody sightlines.
diagram_or_visual_plan_needs.minimum_required_detail: Use the six fixed zones, three routes, two sightline lanes, six camera slots, and three ore-gate states declared in the visual plan.

acceptance_notes: The first pass caught a local-versus-habitat-scale error that placed outer-shell aggregate beside the hub collar. The repaired artifact uses a rotating-side frame-transfer bearing and pressure collar, with the habitat shell elsewhere.
The opening now defines the gravity transition, and every movement follows a named route compatible with worker position and equipment.
Folded scenes preserve ore-gate, life-safety bypass, record custody, supply-window, and crew-exhaustion states through conditional prose or visual modifiers.

review_notes: The four reviewer prompts were applied as separate narrative, lore, visual, and spatial self-review passes after drafting.
Static checks confirmed valid JSON, one-to-one Ink/visual scene ids, branch tags and knots, referenced visual characters and modifier targets, affirmative base prompts, and no unused Ink variables.
Per the task contract, Ink was not compiled and no images were rendered.
A real plan view or 3D blockout remains required before high-consistency multi-angle website art; the prompt manifest is ready for deferred concept rendering.
